name: Temporary Residence -- Family Reunification

requirement_groups.name: Spouse or extramarital partner of a citizen or resident

requirements.blocker_text: Spouse of a Serbian citizen; spouse of a foreign national holding Serbian temporary/permanent residence or granted asylum; or a partner in a registered extramarital (common-law) union with a Serbian citizen or such a resident.

requirement_groups.name: Other family member of a citizen or resident

requirements.blocker_text: Family member (as defined by Serbian law -- e.g. minor child, dependent parent) of a Serbian citizen or of a foreign citizen holding temporary or permanent residence.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate or proof of extramarital union
Birth certificate or other proof of kinship
Sponsor's proof of citizenship or residence/protection status

outcome.duration_length: up to 3 years, renewable, generally tied to the sponsor's status

sources.title: Welcome to Serbia (official government portal) -- family reunification categories: spouse of a Serbian citizen or resident/asylum-grantee, extramarital partner, and other family members of a citizen or resident

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Serbia). No specific sponsor income or housing-adequacy threshold was found on the tier-1 government page reviewed -- the page explicitly defers documentation specifics to separate linked resources not captured in this pass, so no numeric financial requirement is modeled here (consistent with this dataset's practice of disclosing a gap rather than inventing a figure). work_rights modeled 'none' since no work authorization was described as bundled with this ground specifically. A foreign spouse of a Serbian CITIZEN can alternatively pursue rs_citizenship_by_marriage.json directly (after 3 years of marriage plus permanent residence) rather than only extending temporary residence indefinitely -- both are modeled as separate, valid routes.
